prerequisite_gate: O06 evidence must be reviewed independently; mainline controls chapter status

dimensions.scope: contract, data/permission model, alternatives and maintenance cost
negative cases, current membership, privacy and object boundaries
actual independent requests, revision/replay conflicts, partial and uncertain failures
populated upgrade, compatibility, safe rollback and reproducible artifacts
real isolated restore, measured objectives, invited feedback
unseen change, diagnosis defense, honest assistance disclosure

counterexamples: 100% coverage is not object authorization evidence
backup file existence is not restoration
passing evidence formatter is not backend verification
local HTTP success is not HTTPS public deployment
decision_owner: human reviewer; no script can award graduation
non_hard_gate_note: Every scenario covers a required contract; false hard_gate is not a waiver. Scores assess quality beyond the minimum behavior, not permission to leave required behavior broken.
